title: The Last Train Enters the Depot

segments.text: [soft, slow, warm voice] [faint distant train rumble] [softly] Lie down and adjust anything that needs support. This is deliberate rest, not a substitute for sleep. Imagine the last train of the evening entering a quiet depot.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Feel the left foot and toes as the first carriage becomes still... sole... heel... ankle... calf... knee... thigh.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Let the whole left leg rest on its track. Nothing to lift, brace, or carry.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Move through the right toes... sole... heel... ankle... calf... knee... and thigh. The second line powers down.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Feel both legs together, heavy or light, detailed or vague. The depot accepts every kind of arrival.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Notice pelvis, hips, and lower back. Let the belly move without instructions while the central carriage settles.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Feel lower ribs, chest, shoulder blades, and upper back. With each exhale, another overhead light clicks off.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Travel through the left fingers, palm, wrist, forearm, elbow, upper arm, and shoulder. Let the arm be parked for the night.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Now right fingers, palm, wrist, forearm, elbow, upper arm, and shoulder. Allow both hands to release their imaginary luggage.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Notice throat, jaw, lips, tongue, cheeks, and the tiny muscles beside the nose. Let the face stop announcing where it is going.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Feel eyes, brow, forehead, temples, ears, and scalp. The destination board becomes blank.
[soft, slow, warm voice] Sense the whole head... whole torso... both arms... both legs. The train is complete and motionless enough.
[soft, slow, warm voice] [reassuringly] You may be awake, dreamy, restless, or nearly asleep. Rest does not require a particular platform.
[soft, slow, warm voice] [softly] Deepen the breath. Move fingers and toes, stretch if wanted, and return as the depot begins switching on its morning lights.
